subject.title: normalizeGitHubActor: not idempotent — strips only one trailing [bot]

question: Should requester grouping collapse every repeated trailing `[bot]` suffix while mutation authorization continues comparing the raw submitted actor?
rationale: The normalization invariant is straightforward, but choosing where normalized identity may flow affects a trusted mutation boundary and requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Normalize grouping only
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/576 after confirming normalized actors are confined to grouping and repeated-suffix actors remain unauthorized.

options.title: Retain single-strip behavior
options.body: Keep the current behavior and document that malformed repeated suffixes are intentionally not canonicalized.

recommendation.title: Normalize grouping only
recommendation.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/576 after confirming normalized actors are confined to grouping and repeated-suffix actors remain unauthorized.

likelyOwner.reason: They explicitly requested deliberate review of this exact normalization and mutation-authorization boundary.
